# Mercury API reference

Use this page when looking up the Mercury API or mx CLI. It is an authored reference index, not a generated catalog of every symbol.

- [Hyperscript API](/hyperscript/llms.txt): h, render, JSX and hooks.
- [Mercury UI API](/ui/llms.txt): components and CSS tokens.
- [Hypergraph units](/hypergraph/units/llms.txt): store, event and effect.
- [mx CLI](/mx/llms.txt) and [installation](/start/install-mx/llms.txt).
- [Live Mercury](/live-mercury/llms.txt): optional Phoenix and LiveView integration.
- [Public HTTP API index](/api) and [OpenAPI 3.1 description](/openapi.json): read-only discovery, release metadata and the MCP HTTP boundary.
- [MCP connection guide](/start/mcp/llms.txt): use MCP initialization and discovery; this is JSON-RPC, not a REST substitute. `/api` errors use RFC 9457; MCP errors retain JSON-RPC envelopes.
- [Public distribution repository](https://github.com/fiberfx/mercury).

Use the exact package entry points from each chapter. Preserve existing application pins and check current readiness before installing tools.
